snippet.title: Jurassic Architect | Official Trailer | Build a Dinosaur Zoo Beyond the Portal
snippet.description:
Build a cozy dinosaur zoo on the far side of a Portal. Visitors from our world buy tickets to meet real dinosaurs. Shape enclosures, research new species, hire keepers, rangers and vets, and keep fourteen kinds of dinosaurs happy before they start testing their fences.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1737370/Jurassic_Architect/

- 14 dinosaur species with names, needs, eggs and babies
- Enclosures of any shape with wood, steel or electric fences that can break
- Research with Knowledge and a Paleopedia of real facts
- Keepers, rangers and vets; illness and old age
- Daily events and expeditions through the Portal into the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous
- Scenarios with star ratings and 19 Steam Achievements

Every shot is recorded in the game.

MadOctopus | https://madoctopus.fun

#JurassicArchitect #dinosaurs #citybuilder
